title: Autoclave Cycles & Temperatures: Numbers & Measurements
description: Communicate sterilizer temperatures in Celsius (121°C), cycle times in minutes, and steam pressure in bar.
learning_objectives: State technical temperatures, pressures, and durations accurately in English
Use prepositions with measurements: at 121°C, for 20 minutes, to 2.1 bar
Avoid common Czenglish measurement phrasing mistakes

questions.prompt: The steam autoclave sterilizes surgical instruments _____ 121 degrees Celsius.

explanations.correct: Specific operational temperatures take preposition 'at': 'at 121 degrees Celsius'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'při 121 stupních Celsia'. Exact operating temperatures take 'at': 'at 121°C'.

questions.prompt: The sterilization holding phase must continue _____ exactly 20 minutes.

explanations.correct: Duration of time takes preposition 'for': 'for 20 minutes'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'during' is followed by an event noun ('during the cycle'), not a duration number.
explanations.wrong_D: 'since' indicates starting point in the past.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'po dobu 20 minut'. Duration of time takes 'for': 'for 20 minutes'.

questions.prompt: The chamber pressure reaches _____ of 2.1 bar during the saturated steam cycle.

explanations.correct: Noun phrase takes 'a maximum of 2.1 bar'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'dosahuje maxima 2,1 bar'. Standard technical formula: 'reaches a maximum of 2.1 bar'.

questions.prompt: How _____ steam pressure is currently recorded inside the sterilization chamber?

explanations.wrong_B: 'much of' is incorrect before bare noun.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'Kolik tlaku páry...?'. Uncountable nouns take 'How much steam pressure'.

questions.prompt: The cooling cycle brings the temperature down _____ room temperature (22°C).

explanations.correct: Endpoint of a reduction or change takes preposition 'to': 'down to room temperature'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'at' indicates fixed position, not endpoint of change.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'ochlazuje na pokojovou teplotu'. Endpoint of temperature drop takes 'down to'.

questions.prompt: The autoclave door cannot be opened until the chamber pressure drops _____ 0.05 bar.

explanations.correct: On numerical scales (temperature, pressure), lower value takes 'below': 'below 0.05 bar'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'under' is common, but 'below' is the strictly preferred technical standard for scales.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'klesne pod 0,05 bar'. Measurements on a numerical scale use 'below'.

questions.prompt: The sterilizer holds _____ ten stainless steel trays per cycle.

explanations.correct: Upper capacity limit takes 'up to': 'up to ten trays'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'až 10 nerezových táců'. Upper capacity limit takes 'up to ten trays'.

questions.prompt: The vacuum leak test takes approximately _____ and a half minutes to complete.

explanations.correct: Cardinal number 'seven' pairs with 'seven and a half minutes'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'seven of' is incorrect before 'and a half'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'sedm a půl minuty'. Use cardinal number: 'seven and a half minutes'.

questions.prompt: The drying vacuum pulls the pressure down _____ negative 0.8 bar.

explanations.correct: Reaching an endpoint takes 'to': 'down to negative 0.8 bar'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'na minus 0,8 bar'. Endpoint of pull-down takes 'to negative 0.8 bar'.

questions.prompt: The temperature sensor has an accuracy tolerance of plus or minus 0.5 _____ Celsius.

explanations.correct: Plural noun 'degrees' follows decimals and numerals other than exactly 1: '0.5 degrees Celsius'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech '0,5 stupně Celsia'. Decimals in English take plural 'degrees': '0.5 degrees Celsius'.
